classification.difficultyReason: Follow the completed row, count the vowels in HEART, and use complementary probabilities to fill the remaining cells and sums.

answer.worked:
The vowels are E and A. Each letter is equally likely to be selected.
$$\begin{align*}P(\text{vowel})&=\frac25\\P(\text{not vowel})&=1-\frac25\\P(\text{not vowel})&=\frac35\\P(\text{vowel})+P(\text{not vowel})&=\frac25+\frac35\\P(\text{vowel})+P(\text{not vowel})&=1\end{align*}$$
